source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.
source.original_treatment_name: Sideroxylon lanuginosum Michx. subsp. oblongifolium (Nutt.) T.D. Penn.

historic_subspecies_only.habit: Shrub or small tree to 15 m or more
historic_subspecies_only.leaves: Alternate or clustered short shoots, leathery entire oblanceolate or elliptic leaves, underside gray or tawny cobwebby hair
historic_subspecies_only.flowers: Small axillary umbel-like clusters with yellow-white five-lobed corolla, five stamens and five staminodes

source_scope_note: Historic taxonomic rank maintained; comparative key traits or family-only descriptions not automatically promoted to accepted species level.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Flora explicitly treats subsp. oblongifolium and includes subsp. albicans within it; does not authorize entire species morphology across subspecies
Historical Bumelia lanuginosa var. oblongifolia synonym preserved
preservation: Additive species source references only; no original records, photos, credits or galleries changed
